label: Sender address
help: Bare email address used in the approved From header.

label: Allowed recipients
help: JSON array of exact email addresses, e.g. ["recipient@example.org"]. No wildcard.

label: Enable approved sending
help: Off by default. Every send still requires an exact draft/revision approval on decision.

label: IMAP server
help: DNS name or IPv4 address, without a URL scheme or port.

label: IMAP port
help: Usually 993 for TLS, 143 for STARTTLS.

label: IMAP encryption
help: TLS is mandatory and the certificate is verified.

label: IMAP wallet reference
help: secret://workspace/mail_account. The secret is JSON with username and password; never paste credentials here.

label: Mailbox
help: ASCII mailbox name. Read-only access; messages are not marked as read.

label: SMTP server
help: DNS name or IPv4 address. Required before preparing a draft.

label: SMTP port
help: Usually 465 for TLS, 587 for STARTTLS.

label: SMTP encryption
help: Verified TLS only. All recipients must be accepted before sending content.

label: SMTP wallet reference
help: JSON wallet secret with username and password. It may be the same reference as IMAP.

label: Outgoing attachment directory
help: Only regular files inside this directory can be attached. Snapshots are copied into the block’s private storage.

label: Extract received attachments
help: Save bounded copies under generated filenames in private block storage; never execute them.

label: Custom CA file (optional)
help: PEM certificate authority file. Empty uses system trust; this never disables certificate verification.

label: Network deadline (seconds)
help: Hard deadline per exchange. Stop terminates the block-owned network process.

label: Maximum MIME size (bytes)
help: Applies to one complete received or prepared message. Default 5 MiB.

label: Maximum body length
help: Drafts exceeding this length are refused; received text is truncated with an explicit flag.

label: Messages per search
help: Maximum number of message summaries returned by one command.

label: UID search window
help: Default search covers the newest UID window. Use explicit cursors to scan older mail.

label: Attachments per message
help: Limit both received extraction and outgoing drafts.

label: Draft lifetime (seconds)
help: Expired drafts cannot be sent. Prepare a new request instead.

label: Minimum send interval (seconds)
help: Commands received too early are refused, not queued or automatically retried.

label: Maximum journal records
help: Preserve deduplication history. At the limit, new requests are refused; nothing is purged.

label: Private storage limit (bytes)
help: Includes drafts, received attachments and the journal. Default 128 MiB; no automatic cleanup.
